results.question: Ho delle chat di gruppo nei messaggi diretti di Instagram, o sono tutte conversazioni individuali?
results.answer: I have both individual 1:1 direct messages and group chats in Instagram direct messages. The `is_group` column distinguishes them: 0 for individual conversations (655 instances) and 1 for group chats (52 instances).

columns.name: participants
columns.semantic_note: native display names, '; '-joined — includes the project owner's own name (Instagram's export lists every participant, not just the other side), so a normal 1:1 DM already shows 2 names here; see is_group for the actual group/1:1 distinction

columns.name: is_group
columns.semantic_note: derived, deterministic: 1 when more than one participant besides the project owner, 0 otherwise

columns.name: message_count
columns.semantic_note: native — total messages in this thread across all message_*.json parts, counted regardless of sampling

columns.name: is_sampled
columns.semantic_note: 1 if this is one of the 20 busiest threads (see instagram_ingest.TOP_N_THREADS_FOR_FULL_TEXT) — only those threads have matching rows in instagram_direct_messages; every other thread has metadata here only, by explicit MVP scoping, not a data gap
